content:
{'content': 'Apple TV 剛為訂閱用戶加入大量經典電影，而此舉恰逢該串流平台一個電影特別密集的秋季陣容前夕。', 'translation': 'Apple TV has just added a large batch of classic films for its subscribers, and the move comes ahead of what is shaping up to be a particularly movie-heavy fall slate for the streaming service.'}

{'content': 'Apple TV 新增電影 迎接秋季重磅片單', 'translation': 'Apple TV Adds Movies Ahead of Fall Slate'}

{'content': '電影正迎來屬於自己的高光時刻。《壯志凌雲：獨行俠》、《蜘蛛俠：全新日》、《着迷》等賣座大片，似乎顯示出社會上對電影的熱情正在升溫。', 'translation': "Movies are having a moment. Blockbusters like Top Gun: Maverick, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, and Obsession seem to indicate that society's enthusiasm for film is on the rise."}

{'content': '而 Apple 看來準備乘勢而上。', 'translation': 'And Apple looks ready to capitalize.'}

{'content': '本週 Apple TV 為訂閱用戶免費加入大量經典電影。片目因地區而異，在美國的片單包括《火星任務》、《天煞異降》、《失蹤罪》、《求愛嫁公主》、《殺人回憶》、，《龍虎少年隊》等熱門作品。', 'translation': 'This week, Apple TV added a large library of classic films for its subscribers at no extra cost. The lineup varies by region, with the U.S. slate including popular titles like The Martian, Arrival, Prisoners, The Princess Bride, Memories of Murder, and 21 Jump Street.'}

{'content': '隨著這些新片加入，Apple 的電影庫基本上在一夜之間翻了一倍。', 'translation': "With these additions, Apple's film library has essentially doubled overnight."}

{'content': '買入這些電影授權並不代表 Apple 放棄自家原創電影。事實上，這批突如其來的影片上架，恰好趕在一個陣容鼎盛、全新電影的秋季檔期之前。', 'translation': "Licensing these movies doesn't mean Apple is giving up on its own original films. In fact, the sudden influx arrives just ahead of a packed fall slate of brand-new movies."}

{'content': 'Apple TV 秋季共有六部新片即將登場：', 'translation': 'Apple TV has six new films coming this fall:'}

  • {'content': '9月4日：《Mayday》', 'translation': 'September 4: Mayday'}
  • {'content': '10月2日：《The Last First: Winter K2》', 'translation': 'October 2: The Last First: Winter K2'}
  • {'content': '10月9日：《Matchbox The Movie》', 'translation': 'October 9: Matchbox The Movie'}
  • {'content': '10月16日：《Tenzing》', 'translation': 'October 16: Tenzing'}
  • {'content': '11月13日：《Being Heumann》', 'translation': 'November 13: Being Heumann'}
  • {'content': '11月25日：《Way of the Warrior Kid》', 'translation': 'November 25: Way of the Warrior Kid'}

{'content': '一直以來，Apple 的電影路線游走於奧斯卡口味作品與更主打大眾的 popcorn 片之間。今個秋季，兩者都有相當均衡的比重。', 'translation': "Apple's film strategy has long balanced Oscar-bait projects with more crowd-pleasing popcorn fare. This fall, there's a fairly even mix of both."}

{'content': '《Mayday》、《Matchbox》與《Way of the Warrior Kid》看起來都是輕鬆有趣的動作片，由 Ryan Reynolds 和 John Cena 等明星掛帥；而《Being Heumann》、《Tenzing》和《The Last First》明顯劍指頒獎禮。', 'translation': 'Mayday, Matchbox, and Way of the Warrior Kid all look like fun, easy action movies starring the likes of Ryan Reynolds and John Cena, while Being Heumann, Tenzing, and The Last First are clearly eyeing awards season.'}

{'content': 'Apple 在劇集方面持續取得佳績，例如剛回歸的《足球教練》。其電影方面的部署如何發展，令人期待。', 'translation': "Apple continues to find success on the TV side, with shows like the recently returned Ted Lasso. It'll be interesting to see how its film strategy develops."}

{'content': 'Apple TV 月費為 12.99 美元，亦可透過 Apple One 組合訂閱享有折扣。', 'translation': 'Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or you can get it at a discount through an Apple One bundle.'}
